result.citation: Ord. No. 188481 and Ord. No. 188482 (section not stated); see also id. L.A. Mun. Code § 165.03(I)(1); L.A. Mun. Code §§ 151.22-151.28
result.note: The RPO ordinances now lead because they hold the relocation rule, but no document states their codified section, so '(section not stated)' is added. The nickname 'Resident Protections Ordinance' is dropped because only the LAHD bulletin uses it. 'LAMC' becomes 'L.A. Mun. Code', and the filing-procedure sections move to see also.
